title: GridSim v1 demand.json
description: The demands of the case, one record each. Optional file. Several demands on one bus are added together by the loader. Member names are case-sensitive here (canonical camelCase spelling), although the v1 loader matches them ignoring case: the case editor refuses to save a non-canonical spelling until it is normalised (Q1, strict). Unknown members are refused, as the loader refuses them (R268). JSON null is refused everywhere: the loader reads null as absent, and the editor removes a member rather than writing null. Numeric ranges mirror the v2 network schema, so a v1 case the editor saves always projects to a valid v2 network. Rules a schema cannot express (bus references resolving, ZIP triples summing to 1, the [VERIFY] honesty rule) are the loader's.

demand.title: Demand
demand.description: A demand (v1 DemandDto). Absent: pMw 0, qMvar from pMw and powerFactor, powerFactor 0.97 lagging.

bus.title: Bus
bus.description: The bus the demand is connected to (must exist in buses.json).

qMvar.title: Reactive power (Mvar)
qMvar.description: Reactive power drawn. Absent: pMw x tan(acos(powerFactor)).

powerFactor.title: Power factor
powerFactor.description: Lagging power factor used when qMvar is absent. Absent: 0.97. The loader clamps it to [0.01, 1]; this schema refuses anything outside (0, 1], as v2 does.
